svg.text: Load Balancing in Data Center Networks
I study how datacenter networks spread traffic
across paths. My MSc thesis implemented CONGA in
ns-3 and explored Power of Two Choices; that
variant did not improve on CONGA.
I’m now evaluating smoothed RTT as a congestion
signal for flowlet routing. Results are
preliminary. Outside research, I build embedded
projects and run a home lab.
An ns-3 flowlet-routing module using smoothed RTT as a congestion signal. Evaluation against
